items.title: Universally injective base change of a flat finite presentation module over a local homomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'Localization and universally injective maps'
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion for N -> N tensor_S S' to be R-universally injective when S -> S' is flat and meets every associated prime of the fibre N/m_R N over the local base (statement lines 1852-1863). The proof is a genuine three-stage reduction: the map is replaced by its Sigma-localisation, the localised ring map Sigma^{-1}S -> Sigma^{-1}S' is shown faithfully flat by matching the maximal ideals of the semi-local ring Sigma^{-1}S with the associated primes of the fibre, and faithful flatness supplies universal injectivity of the tensor map, after which the two remaining pieces are glued by the composition rule (proof lines 1881-1903). No step is a computation; the content is the organisation of six quoted algebra lemmas around one commutative square, so the claim is H2.
